errors.text_span: the bars alternate between two blue hues
errors.evidence: The bars do not alternate in color. Three specific models ('gpt-4o-2024-11-20', 'gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18', and 'gpt-4.1-nano-2025-04-14') are highlighted with a darker blue color across all three charts, while the rest are a lighter blue. This is a specific highlighting scheme, not an alternating pattern.

The description fails to mention that the models are sorted in descending order based on their performance in the 'Understanding' category. This sorting order is a key structural feature of the figure as it is applied to all three charts.
